===Use===
*To add information about maps, link to vods, a short note, etc. use (See [[Template:BracketMatchSummary]] for further details):
* '''Overtime:''' If a map went to overtime, add <mark>|map#ot=1</mark>. The value <mark>1</mark> equals the number of consecutive overtimes, rarely more than <mark>1</mark>.
* '''Walkover:''' If a player leaves WO, add <mark>|R#D#race=wo</mark>. Can also be set to red, green, blue, yellow and white - please avoid this if you can.

*To '''bold''' winners and winners' scores use:
 <nowiki>|R1D1=Playername |R1D1score=2 </nowiki>'''<nowiki>|R1D1win=1</nowiki>'''
*To '''customize the names of the Rounds''' (default: Quarterfinals, Semifinals, Finals) use:
 <nowiki>|R1=
|R2=
|R3=
|R4=
|L4=</nowiki>
*To '''remove Round titles''' completely use:
 <nowiki>|hideroundtitles=true</nowiki>
*To customize '''column width''' or '''score width''' use: 
 <nowiki>|column-width=
|score-width=</nowiki>
